# Ensure all tables render inline at 10pt body font size without horizontal overflow or float page isolation,
# and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens (-).
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  parts <- strsplit(text, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  out_parts <- character(length(parts))
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
      out_parts[i] <- "$"
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "^2", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      out_parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", p, perl = TRUE)
      if (isTRUE(arg1_in_table)) {
        p <- gsub("\\_", "\\_\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("/", "/\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        # Keep thousands-separated numbers and BC/AD dates on a single line inside table cells
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        # Prevent line breaks immediately after a leading negative sign (e.g. -10000)
        p <- gsub("(^|\\s|\\()-([0-9])", "\\1\\\\mbox{-}\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
      }
      out_parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(out_parts, collapse = ""))
}

sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function (arg0_line) {
  line_str <- as.character(arg0_line)
  if (length(line_str) == 0 || is.na(line_str) || !nzchar(line_str)) return(line_str)
  parts <- strsplit(line_str, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", " \\approx ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub(
        "\\b(Figures?|Figs?\\.|Tables?|Tabs?\\.|Images?|Definitions?|Sections?|Appendix)(?:\\s+|~)\\\\ref\\{([^}]+)\\}",
        "\\\\crdxref{\\1}{\\2}",
        p,
        perl = TRUE
      )
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", "~", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(parts, collapse = ""))
}

render_table_template <- function (arg0_df, arg1_options = NULL) {
  df <- as.data.frame(arg0_df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  rownames(df) <- NULL
  options <- if (!is.null(arg1_options)) arg1_options else list()

  caption_str <- if (!is.null(options$caption)) as.character(options$caption) else ""
  col_names <- if (!is.null(options$col_names)) as.character(options$col_names) else colnames(df)
  euro_decimals <- if (!is.null(options$euro_decimals)) isTRUE(options$euro_decimals) else TRUE
  is_latex <- if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) knitr::is_latex_output() else FALSE
  label_str <- if (!is.null(options$label)) as.character(options$label) else ""

  n_cols <- ncol(df)
  n_rows <- nrow(df)
  if (n_rows == 0 || n_cols == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  if (length(col_names) != n_cols) {
    col_names <- colnames(df)
  }
  col_names <- gsub("`", "", col_names, fixed = TRUE)
  col_names <- gsub("\n", " ", col_names, fixed = TRUE)
  col_names <- gsub("([0-9])\\s+(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", col_names, perl = TRUE)
  col_names <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", col_names, fixed = TRUE)
  col_names <- gsub("\u2013", "-", col_names, fixed = TRUE)
  for (c_i in seq_len(n_cols)) {
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("`", "", as.character(df[[c_i]]), fixed = TRUE)
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("\\*\\*", "", as.character(df[[c_i]]))
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", as.character(df[[c_i]]), fixed = TRUE)
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("\u2013", "-", as.character(df[[c_i]]), fixed = TRUE)
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("---", " - ", as.character(df[[c_i]]), fixed = TRUE)
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("--", "-", as.character(df[[c_i]]), fixed = TRUE)
    df[[c_i]] <- gsub("([0-9])\\s+(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", as.character(df[[c_i]]), perl = TRUE)
  }

  if (!is_latex) {
    disp_df <- df
    colnames(disp_df) <- col_names
    for (c_idx in seq_len(n_cols)) {
      disp_df[[c_idx]] <- vapply(
        disp_df[[c_idx]],
        function (v) format_table_cell(v, c_idx, list(bold_first_col = FALSE, euro_decimals = euro_decimals, is_latex = FALSE)),
        character(1)
      )
    }
    kb <- knitr::kable(disp_df, format = "markdown", row.names = FALSE, caption = if (nzchar(caption_str)) caption_str else NULL)
    return(knitr::asis_output(paste(as.character(kb), collapse = "\n")))
  }

  # Calculate safe usable fraction of \textwidth accounting for (n_cols - 1) inter-column gaps
  usable_frac <- max(0.78, 0.962 - 0.0132 * (n_cols - 1L))

  min_frac <- numeric(n_cols)
  col_weights <- numeric(n_cols)
  for (c_idx in seq_len(n_cols)) {
    hdr_str <- col_names[c_idx]
    hdr_words <- unlist(strsplit(hdr_str, "[\\s/\\-]+", perl = TRUE))
    hdr_max_w <- min(11L, max(nchar(hdr_words), 3L))

    cell_vec <- as.character(df[[c_idx]])
    # Treat thousands-separated numbers (1.280,0k) and dates (10000BC) as single unbreakable tokens
    cell_vec_joined <- gsub("([0-9]) ([0-9]{3}\\b)", "\\1_\\2", cell_vec, perl = TRUE)
    cell_vec_joined <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", cell_vec_joined, perl = TRUE)
    cell_words <- unlist(strsplit(paste(cell_vec_joined, collapse = " "), "[\\s/]+", perl = TRUE))
    cell_max_w <- min(11L, max(nchar(cell_words), 3L))

    # Word-fit floor in fraction of 468pt textwidth
    req_pts <- max(hdr_max_w * 4.9 + 3.5, cell_max_w * 4.6 + 3.5, 25.5)
    min_frac[c_idx] <- req_pts / 468.0

    cell_lens <- nchar(cell_vec)
    cell_q85 <- as.numeric(quantile(cell_lens, probs = 0.85, na.rm = TRUE))
    cell_max <- max(cell_lens, nchar(hdr_str), na.rm = TRUE)
    eff_len <- max(nchar(hdr_str) * 0.42, min(cell_max, max(cell_q85, 6.0)))
    col_weights[c_idx] <- if (cell_max <= 7 && nchar(hdr_str) <= 7) 1.1 else max(4.5, eff_len ^ 1.05)
  }

  if (sum(min_frac) > usable_frac * 0.94) {
    min_frac <- min_frac * ((usable_frac * 0.94) / sum(min_frac))
  }
  rem_frac <- max(0.0, usable_frac - sum(min_frac))
  col_fracs <- min_frac + rem_frac * (col_weights / sum(col_weights))

  col_specs <- vapply(
    col_fracs,
    function (fr) sprintf(">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash\\hyphenpenalty=50\\exhyphenpenalty=50}p{%.4f\\textwidth}", fr),
    character(1)
  )
  align_str <- paste(col_specs, collapse = "")

  header_cells <- vapply(
    seq_len(n_cols),
    function (c_idx) {
      clean_h <- sanitize_latex_text(col_names[c_idx], TRUE)
      paste0("{\\karlabold\\lefthyphenmin=5\\righthyphenmin=5 ", clean_h, "}")
    },
    character(1)
  )
  header_line <- paste0(paste(header_cells, collapse = " & "), " \\\\*[4pt]")

  cap_tex <- sanitize_latex_text(caption_str, FALSE)
  lbl_tex <- if (nzchar(label_str)) paste0("\\label{", label_str, "}") else ""
  row_pt <- if (n_rows >= 14L) "1pt" else "2pt"
  arr_str <- if (n_rows >= 14L) "1.0" else "1.08"

  block_lines <- c(
    paste0(strrep("\x60", 3), "{=latex}"),
    "\\par\\vspace{4pt}",
    "\\begingroup\\fontsize{10pt}{14pt}\\selectfont\\normalfont\\rmfamily\\mdseries",
    "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{3pt}",
    paste0("\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{", arr_str, "}"),
    "\\setlength{\\LTpre}{4pt}",
    "\\setlength{\\LTpost}{4pt}",
    "\\setlength{\\LTcapwidth}{\\textwidth}",
    paste0("\\begin{longtable}[l]{@{}", align_str, "@{}}"),
    header_line,
    "\\endfirsthead",
    paste0("\\multicolumn{", n_cols, "}{@{}l@{}}{\\normalfont\\karlalight\\fontsize{9pt}{12pt}\\selectfont (Continued from previous page)} \\\\*[3pt]"),
    header_line,
    "\\endhead"
  )

  for (r_idx in seq_len(n_rows)) {
    row_cells <- vapply(
      seq_len(n_cols),
      function (c_idx) {
        raw_v <- df[r_idx, c_idx]
        val_str <- if (is.null(raw_v) || is.na(raw_v)) "-" else as.character(raw_v)
        val_str <- trimws(gsub("\\*\\*", "", val_str))
        if (euro_decimals) {
          val_str <- convert_euro_decimals_in_text(val_str)
        }
        clean_v <- sanitize_latex_text(val_str, TRUE)
        paste0("{\\normalfont\\rmfamily\\mdseries\\lefthyphenmin=4\\righthyphenmin=4\\hspace{0pt} ", clean_v, "}")
      },
      character(1)
    )
    # Prevent page breaks inside the first 3 rows or the last 4 rows so tables never orphan 1-3 rows
    row_end <- paste0("\\\\[", row_pt, "]")
    if (r_idx == n_rows && (nzchar(cap_tex) || nzchar(lbl_tex))) {
      row_end <- "\\\\*[5pt]"
    }
    block_lines <- c(block_lines, paste0(paste(row_cells, collapse = " & "), " ", row_end))
  }

  if (nzchar(cap_tex) || nzchar(lbl_tex)) {
    block_lines <- c(block_lines, paste0("\\caption{", cap_tex, "}", lbl_tex, "\\\\"))
  }
  block_lines <- c(
    block_lines,
    "\\end{longtable}\\endgroup",
    "\\vspace{4pt}\\par",
    strrep("\x60", 3)
  )

  return(knitr::asis_output(paste(block_lines, collapse = "\n")))
}
orig_render_figure_template <- render_figure_template
render_figure_template <- function (arg0_file_path, arg1_options = NULL) {
  options <- if (!is.null(arg1_options)) arg1_options else list()
  options$placement <- "!htbp"
  if (is.null(options$max_height) || identical(options$max_height, "none")) {
    options$max_height <- "0.42\\textheight"
  }
  return(orig_render_figure_template(arg0_file_path, options))
}

fmt_eu_pop <- function(val) {
  if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(val)
  if (v <= 0) return("-")
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    m <- round(v / 1000000, 2)
    return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", format(m, nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE)), "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    k <- round(v / 1000, 1)
    if (k == floor(k)) {
      return(paste0(as.integer(k), "k"))
    }
    return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", format(k, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)), "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(as.integer(round(v))))
}

fmt_eu_coord <- function(x) {
  s <- format(round(as.numeric(x), 2), nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE)
  gsub("\\.", ",", s)
}

get_entry_pop <- function(entry, yr_str) {
  p <- entry$population[[yr_str]]
  if (is.null(p)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(p)
}

fmt_pct_change <- function(entry) {
  p1 <- get_entry_pop(entry, "1991")
  p2 <- get_entry_pop(entry, "2021")
  if (is.na(p1) || is.na(p2) || p1 <= 0) return("Abandoned")
  pct <- round((p2 - p1) / p1 * 100, 1)
  sign_s <- if (pct > 0) "+" else ""
  paste0(sign_s, gsub("\\.", ",", format(pct, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)), "%")
}

build_region_df <- function(reg_slug) {
  sub_list <- Filter(function(e) identical(as.character(reg35_map[[e$key]]), as.character(reg_slug)), all_entries)
  rows <- lapply(sub_list, function(e) {
    raw_oth <- if (length(e$other_names) > 0) unlist(e$other_names) else character(0)
    if (length(raw_oth) > 1) {
      oth <- paste(head(raw_oth, 2L), collapse = "; ")
    } else if (length(raw_oth) == 1) {
      oth <- raw_oth[1]
    } else {
      oth <- "-"
    }
    coords_span <- paste0(
      fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[1]]), ", ", fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[2]]),
      " (", e$country, ")"
    )
    data.frame(
      `Settlement` = e$name,
      `Alternative / Historical Names` = oth,
      `Coords & Country` = coords_span,
      `1991AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1991")),
      `2002AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "2002")),
      `2010AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "2010")),
      `2014AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "2014")),
      `2021AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "2021")),
      `Change` = fmt_pct_change(e),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

# Overview and 35-Region Census Benchmark Methodology

This supplementary gazetteer compiles 234 individual urban settlements across the 35 demographic regions of the post-Soviet East Slavic and Eurasian space (Belarus Regions 1-3, Ukraine Regions 4-11 including the 2014-2021AD Donbas Minsk Line of Contact split between Government-Controlled Donbas Region 9 and Pre-2022 Occupied Donbas Region 10 plus Annexed Crimea & Sevastopol Region 11, and the Russian Federation Regions 12-35 including disaggregated North Caucasus Regions 22-24 and Siberian/Arctic Regions 26-35) from the dissolution of the USSR (1991AD) to the eve of the full-scale Russo-Ukrainian war (2021AD). Each settlement entry records verified geographic coordinates, historical and alternative toponyms, sovereign country attribution (Belarus, Ukraine, or Russia within internationally recognised 1991AD borders), and positive integer population series across five benchmark slices (1991AD, 2002AD, 2010AD, 2014AD, and 2021AD).

For each settlement, population figures are anchored in official post-Soviet census enumerations and demographic yearbooks: the 1999AD, 2009AD, and 2019AD Population Censuses of the Republic of Belarus (Belstat) [@belstat2000perepis1999; @belstat2010perepis2009; @belstat2020perepis2019], the 2001AD All-Ukrainian Population Census, 2014-2021AD Ukrstat annual municipal series, and 2019AD Electronic Assessment [@ukrstat2003perepis2001; @ukrstat2021naselennia; @dubilet2020assessment2019], and the 2002AD, 2010AD, and 2021AD All-Russian Population Censuses (Rosstat) [@rosstat2004perepis2002; @rosstat2012perepis2010; @rosstat2022perepis2021]. For settlements abandoned during the post-Soviet northern exodus, such as the Kolyma coal-mining town of Kadykchan in Region 34 (10.300 in 1991AD and 875 in 2002AD), population series are reported up to their final inhabited benchmark prior to complete evacuation.

}

# Minsk Metropolitan Magnet (Belarus)

Table \ref{tab:reg1-sites} lists the catalogued urban settlements in Region 1 (Minsk City & Minsk Oblast Metropolitan Magnet), where total regional population shifted from 3.400k in 1991AD to 3.480k in 2021AD (+2,4%) [@belstat2020perepis2019; @ukrstat2021naselennia; @rosstat2022perepis2021].

```{r table-reg1, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_reg1 <- build_region_df("belarus_minsk_city_and_oblast_magnet")
render_table_template(
  df_reg1,
  list(
    caption = "Urban settlements and benchmark population trajectories in Region 1 from 1991AD to 2021AD.",
    label = "tab:reg1-sites"
  )
)
```

# 35-Region Gazetteer Summary (1991AD - 2021AD)

Table \ref{tab:regional-summary} summarises the number of catalogued urban settlements (n = 234) and their combined urban sample population across all 35 regions from 1991AD to 2021AD. Across the entire sample of 234 primary and secondary cities, combined urban population rose from 98,92M in 1991AD to 104,20M in 2021AD (+5,3%), reflecting the concentration of post-Soviet populations into major metropolitan agglomerations (Regions 1, 5, 12, 13, 18, 21, 24, 26) even as rural countrysides, conflict zones (Regions 9, 10, 22), and Northern/coal-mining *monogoroda* (Regions 15, 28, 31, 34, 35) contracted sharply.

```{r table-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
bench_yrs <- c("1991", "2002", "2010", "2014", "2021")

sum_rows <- lapply(seq_along(summary_meta$regions), function(idx) {
  reg <- summary_meta$regions[[idx]]
  rslug <- as.character(reg$id)
  sub_e <- Filter(function(e) identical(as.character(reg35_map[[e$key]]), rslug), all_entries)
  raw_sums <- sapply(bench_yrs, function(y) {
    vals <- sapply(sub_e, function(e) {
      v <- get_entry_pop(e, y)
      if (is.na(v)) 0 else v
    })
    sum(vals)
  })
  sums <- sapply(raw_sums, fmt_eu_pop)
  pct <- round((raw_sums[["2021"]] - raw_sums[["1991"]]) / raw_sums[["1991"]] * 100, 1)
  pct_s <- paste0(if (pct > 0) "+" else "", gsub("\\.", ",", format(pct, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)), "%")
  data.frame(
    `Region (Catalogued Cities)` = paste0(reg$name, " (n = ", length(sub_e), ")"),
    `1991AD` = sums[["1991"]],
    `2002AD` = sums[["2002"]],
    `2010AD` = sums[["2010"]],
    `2014AD` = sums[["2014"]],
    `2021AD` = sums[["2021"]],
    `Sample Change` = pct_s,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_sum <- do.call(rbind, sum_rows)

tot_raw <- sapply(bench_yrs, function(y) {
  vals <- sapply(all_entries, function(e) {
    v <- get_entry_pop(e, y)
    if (is.na(v)) 0 else v
  })
  sum(vals)
})
tot_sums <- sapply(tot_raw, fmt_eu_pop)
tot_pct <- round((tot_raw[["2021"]] - tot_raw[["1991"]]) / tot_raw[["1991"]] * 100, 1)
tot_pct_s <- paste0(if (tot_pct > 0) "+" else "", gsub("\\.", ",", format(tot_pct, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)), "%")

tot_row <- data.frame(
  `Region (Catalogued Cities)` = paste0("Total Gazetteer Sample (n = ", length(all_entries), ")"),
  `1991AD` = tot_sums[["1991"]],
  `2002AD` = tot_sums[["2002"]],
  `2010AD` = tot_sums[["2010"]],
  `2014AD` = tot_sums[["2014"]],
  `2021AD` = tot_sums[["2021"]],
  `Sample Change` = tot_pct_s,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
df_sum <- rbind(df_sum, tot_row)

render_table_template(
  df_sum,
  list(
    caption = "Combined urban sample population across the 234 catalogued settlements by thirty-five post-Soviet regions from 1991AD to 2021AD.",
    label = "tab:regional-summary"
  )
)
```
